title: Surendra

card.teaser: A typeface drawn from old wood and metal type specimens. Every heading on this site is set in it.

summary: A digital typeface drawn from historical wood and metal type, shown in a specimen poster. Every heading on this site is set in it.

hero.alt: An open magazine with the headline "It was raining inside" set in Surendra.

overview.challenge: Reinterpret old wood and metal type specimens as a new digital typeface, instead of just copying an archival one.
overview.solution: I drew the glyph set from those references, then worked through spacing, kerning and consistency across every character.
overview.outcome: A working display face and a specimen poster that shows off its forms. It is also the voice of this whole site.
